card.name: Words leading into cardiovascular event outcomes
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "as" and "-first" just before a list or name of cardiovascular outcomes, such as major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE), in trial results and warnings.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words right before a cardiovascular outcome such as heart attack, stroke or heart failure is named.
